methodology.title: منهجية استخراج مواضيع الكتابة (Writing Topics)
methodology.description: يتم استخراج مواضيع الكتابة من نهاية كل درس في كتاب الطالب وكتاب النشاط.

topics.title: Write a letter to your boss about leaving your job.
guiding_questions: Why did you decide to leave your job?
How do you feel about leaving?
What are your plans for the future?
topics.sample_essay:
Dear Harry,
I am writing to tell you about my decision to leave my job. I enjoyed working with you, but I find it difficult to arrive on time every morning. I moved to the countryside, so the journey is very long. I'm sorry to leave, but I have to. Thank you for your help during my time with the company.
Yours,
Tom

topics.title: Write a paragraph about how you spend your free time.
guiding_questions: What do you do in your free time?
How often do you do these activities?
topics.sample_essay: I enjoy spending my free time doing different activities. I like playing football with my friends. I also go swimming every weekend. Sometimes I watch films with my family. I love reading books because they help me learn new things. My free time makes me happy and helps me relax after a long day.
